_comment: The single source of citable figures for public Gyre docs. A public claim must carry an inline tag <!-- claim:GYR-NN --> bound to an entry here; scripts/check_claims.py enforces it (see docs/measurement-stance.md for the posture). Statuses: confirmed | provisional | contested | cannot-claim. Numbers here are RESULTS on the stated tier, not instrument parameters.

GYR-01.statement: On synthetic ground truth, the sensor ladder improves pooled F1 from 0.87 (best naive baseline, oracle-thresholded) to 0.94 (evidence-x-semantic, self-deciding).
GYR-01.evidence: scripts/eval_synthetic.py + gyre.bench (per-trace reset default); internal E1 record 2026-07-17

verify.note: the ladder's ordering is the claim: instrument > evidence-naive > diff-naive on the evidence corpus

GYR-02.statement: Across cost regimes in the E2/E4 simulator, adaptive control's worst-case regret is 0.15-0.17 vs 0.50 for the best fixed policy and 0.76 for the best blind heuristic.

GYR-03.statement: On synthetic ground truth, a local instrument (F1 0.94) beats a per-step LLM judge (F1 0.92) with better precision at roughly 1/1000 the cost, and the judge fails the construct-subtle cells.

GYR-04.statement: Real-trace validity: incidence of loop pathologies in real agent traces, and sensor performance on them.
GYR-04.evidence: PINNED until expert anchoring and maintainer sign-off. Preliminary panel-labelled and outcome-labelled real-trace results exist internally (2026-07) but are not publicly assertable.

GYR-05.statement: The reasoning-loop demo cuts a circling thinking stream at onset, saving ~47% of the demo's thinking tokens.

GYR-06.statement: A judge panel absorbs a measurable fraction of human verification burden.
GYR-06.evidence: PINNED. A burden-reduction figure is only assertable when published TOGETHER with a Wilson upper bound on the escape rate, measured by expert audit of a RANDOM sample of the AUTO-APPROVED stratum (gyre.verification_audit). Burden reduction alone is gameable: auto-approving everything scores 100%. Ceiling and audit size must be pre-registered; audit_sample_size_for inverts the exact bound the gate enforces (35 items for a 10% ceiling, 73 for 5%).
